RestServiceDefinition.SqlExecute:
--get resource roles that should be removed from Access Package SELECT json_extract(resourceRoleScopes_role_json,"$.id") as roleId, json_extract(resourceRoleScopes_role_json,"$.displayName") as resourceroleName, servicePrincipals.appId, systems.displayName, br.rolename, br.systemdescription, resourceRoleScopes_Id as ScopeId FROM existingResourceRoles left join servicePrincipals on servicePrincipals.id = json_extract(resourceRoleScopes_scope_json,"$.originId") left join systems on servicePrincipals.appId = systems.appid left join businessrole br on br.rolename = json_extract(resourceRoleScopes_role_json,"$.displayName") and br.systemdescription = systems.displayName
where servicePrincipals.appId is null or rolename is null or systemdescription is null order by br.rolename, br.systemdescription
